name: The Reel-Mother
lore: The Woodfolk say every weaver in the Northwold came out of Blackgill, and every weaver in Blackgill came out of one. When the Skarl left the delving she climbed up into the dark of it and went down to the bottom, where the shaft had drowned, and strung it from wall to wall, and has not come up. Whatever falls into her web she keeps: silk-thieves' lamps, a clansman's axe, a boy's whistle that plays when the draught comes up the shaft. She is very old, and very patient, and she does not like to be hurried.

phases.name: the brood
phases.say: She tears the web from the shaft's walls and it comes down in sheets, and out of every sheet something small starts to run.
